rubric.event_id: Annotate core event meaning, ignoring wording, outfits, camera and location. Reuse IDs for semantic repeats across runs of the same concept.
rubric.domain_action_relevance: 0-1: the idea demonstrates an actual activity in the requested domain, not mere domain props in a portrait.
rubric.generic_pose: 0 or 1: generic posing replaced meaningful concept-specific action. A relevant quiet activity is not automatically generic.
rubric.advanced_pose_fidelity: 0-1: defining support/contact, limb arrangement, balance and equipment mechanics survive in scene and pose_detail.
rubric.final_prompt_scene_fidelity: 0-1: fixed action and participant roles survive in final prose without generic simplification.
rubric.required_fact_fidelity: 0-1: fixed facts remain; permitted variation is not incorrectly locked.
rubric.forbidden_content: 0 or 1: the prompt positively introduces a prohibited concept, separate from exclusion wording.
rubric.negative_language_leakage: 0 or 1: the positive description verbalizes an exclusion instead of applying it silently. Literal rendered text is exempt.
